{{Quote|Orbital Security Station Six to Coruscant Control. Checking in. Nothing to see here but stars&hellip;|Femi|<ref name="TOP" />}}
'''Orbital Security Station Six''' was a [[Orbital security station/Legends|security station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], monitoring [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traffic, in [[3653 BBY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was locked in the [[Great Galactic War]], a conflict between a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic, but, as a gesture of peace from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the two factions met on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to [[Alderaan peace conference|negotiate]] an end to hostilities. In reality, this was just a ruse to allow the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Sacking of Coruscant|directly attack]] Coruscant. Orbital Security Station Six was the first [[Space station/Legends|facility]] to encounter the mass of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warships]], requesting clearance codes from the Sith [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. Moments later, the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] was destroyed in a barrage of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] from the Sith fleet before the assault party descended upon the planet.

==Description==
Orbital Security Station Six was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] used by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] to monitor [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traffic on and off the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It shared this role with other [[Orbital security station/Legends|orbital security stations]] assigned to various other planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Orbital Security Station Six was painted [[red]] and [[gray]] and roughly resembled the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|sigil]] {{AurB|v}} in form. One side of the craft was adorned with two cylinders lined with [[blue]] and [[black]] surfaces. There was a way to transfer workers aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]] on- and off-planet as their shifts changed. The station had designated rooms on the inside, from which workers monitored the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]]. Several instruments, such as various [[Computer/Legends|computers]], assisted them with this task. The facility was equipped with a [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]], allowing the crew to communicate with [[Coruscant Control]] and ships when it was required.<ref name="TOP" />

==History==
Orbital Security Station Six was in orbit above the planet Coruscant in the [[Time/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]], monitoring starship traffic on and off Coruscant for Coruscant Security. [[Femi]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked aboard the craft, checked into a dispatcher over a radio, reporting that there was nothing in her vicinity. Femi then noticed an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] entering [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and, surprised by the unexpected arrival, requested clearance codes from them. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] and the Republic were currently meeting at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to [[Alderaan peace conference|discuss terms]] for ending the [[Great Galactic War]], a galaxy-wide conflict that had been taking place between the two factions for almost three decades, and the unexpected arrival of the Sith fleet caught Femi off-guard. Rather than transmit a response back to her, the Sith fleet destroyed Orbital Security Station Six, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the crew, after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral|Angral]], the leader of the assault, ordered his ship to fire upon the satellite. This began the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a battle that resulted in great repercussions upon the Republic, strong-arming the government into [[Treaty of Coruscant|ceding]] many outlying worlds to the Sith in exchange for a truce.<ref name="TOP" />

==Commanders and crew==
The orbital security station had at least two crew members. Femi was responsible for checking into traffic control. Alongside her was a fair-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Femi's co-worker|co-worker]] who serviced other panels aboard the craft. Femi and her co-worker wore a uniform with a black torso, white shoulder pads, and white sleeves. Their pants were also white.<ref name="TOP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orbital Security Station Six was created for the first issue of the [[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant|opening arc]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|web comic]] serving as a prequel to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] produced by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOP" />
